issue: System icon-change alert appears when opening V Voice
cause: Foreground lifecycle calls AppIconBranding.refreshWhenIdle, which can invoke UIApplication.setAlternateIconName. UIKit presents the icon-change alert for that operation.
fix: Remove automatic icon selection and its helper. Retain primary and legacy alternate portrait assets and idle shortcut metadata updates.
